name: krea
description: Use Krea's creative AI suite to generate, edit, enhance, and produce visual work across Krea models.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, enhance, and edit images and videos with Krea.
interface.longDescription: This plugin turns Codex into an open-ended Krea creative agent: describe what you want to make, improve, restyle, upscale, adapt for marketing, or turn into a visual workflow, and the agent routes the task through the right Krea surface and available models. Use it for quick image and video generation, generative editing, realtime exploration, high-resolution enhancement, LoRA/custom model workflows, product and campaign creative, architecture and interior visualization, and more.
defaultPrompt: Render a photorealistic hillside villa at golden hour with floor-to-ceiling glass and an infinity pool
Make a 15-second cinematic launch video for 'Kestra', an electric city bike brand, riding misty dawn streets
Create a 10-second skincare campaign video for 'Velora' glow serum: dewy skin, water ripples, soft light
